inputs.goal: migrate the orders schema to the normalized v3 shape without downtime

steps.name: preparation
actions: Analyze current orders schema structure and dependencies
Create new normalized v3 order schemas in the database

steps.name: data_migration_start
actions: Add new columns to the orders table for tracking migration state
Add a job to migrate existing records to the normalized schema over time
steps.compensators: Remove new columns and rollback partially migrated data

steps.name: parallel_data_migration
actions: Periodically migrate batches of orders from old format to normalized v3 format
Track migration progress using the added columns
compensators: Stop migration job and rollback partially migrated data

steps.name: dual_writes_initiation
actions: Modify application code to support dual writes (both v2 and v3 schema)
Implement dual-read capability for API consumers that need to read both formats
compensators: Remove dual-write and dual-read capabilities from the code

steps.name: verification
actions: Verify data consistency between old and new schemas
Run end-to-end tests on application with dual writes/reads enabled
compensators: Review test failures, fix critical regressions or revert changes

steps.name: switch_over
actions: Remove write access from old v2 schema tables
Update all read operations to use the new normalized v3 schema
compensators: Re-enable write access on old schema and revert reading operations

steps.name: cleanup
actions: Remove old schema tables after verification of successful migration
Clean up any temporary migration state columns
compensators: Restore removed tables from backup, if needed
